heading: Precision Oxygen Delivery. Designed for Readiness.
lead: BHOC is designed for veterinarians to support oxygen delivery whenever tissue oxygenation is compromised, including situations where donor blood is unavailable, delayed or difficult to provide.
text: Development profile: formulation, shelf life, dosing, safety and efficacy require product-specific and species-specific verification.
